name: Recoverability Corridor Registry
purpose: Define admissible transformation corridors that preserve bounded reconstructability without collapsing projection distinctions.

corridor_classes.definition: Transformation paths where source-relation traceability remains GOLD or SILVER throughout.
Corridors where projection deformation accumulates but remains within defined recovery bounds.
Paths constrained by mandatory conflict preservation (e.g., discrete/smooth boundary).
Corridors approaching deformation limits where projection distinctions may be lost.
Transformation paths that have exceeded recoverability limits.

corridor_properties.definition: Measures the persistence of the source-relation link along the corridor.
Evaluates the degree to which projection-domain distinctions are preserved.
The rate at which feature loss increases per transformation step.
Boolean check if the corridor is mandated to preserve specific neighborhood conflicts.

governance_rules.rule: Every recoverability corridor must declare its stability class and loss accumulation rate.
Corridors with RC_COLLAPSE_RISK status trigger mandatory drift detection reviews.

forbidden_claims: Stable corridors derive physical conservation laws.
Corridor continuity proves the existence of a source manifold.
Terminated corridors justify the deletion of historical trace metadata.
